status: draft for the eval owners (Lakshmi, the senior analyst) and the compliance head; not yet agreed
strata: the field's source page: handwritten Telugu, or printed (Day 14's handwritten_telugu stratum)

auto_accept.note: fitted on the development split only (Day 14, section 02.5): the lowest threshold above which at least 15 development fields with no deterministic finding were all correct

reject.note: below this confidence the value is not offered and the analyst keys it from the page, because a wrong guess on screen anchors the reader; the model's own 'unsure' is always in this band

confirm.basis: the senior analyst's own keying error on the golden set, 1.50 percent (Day 14, section 03.9): an auto-accepted field must be no worse than a careful person re-keying it
confirm.on_failure: the cell's auto-accept band is withdrawn and the cell joins the standing forced-look list; a failed confirmation may only remove automation, never move a threshold (moving one needs new development data)

proof_before_auto.basis: the senior analyst: 'the reading of anything handwritten, until it has proved itself on my hundred' (Day 6, transcript 09); Day 10 risk R1. A handwritten Telugu cell is auto-accepted only when its own test fields bound its error at or below 1.5 percent

seconds.basis: assumptions until the review screen's timer measures pilot week 1: 2 s to glance at a value beside its source; 12 s to read a crop and confirm; 45 s more to correct; 58 s to key a field from the page (Day 9: 0.97 hours of re-keying for about sixty fields)

impact.note: how much a wrong value costs downstream: 3 feeds an eligibility rule or the core-system record of money or identity; to be agreed with the eval owners

files_per_month_basis: the paper and PDF intake workload (about 60 percent of about 2,400 applications a month)
